summary: A cleaned, downloadable CSV of all Florida-licensed real estate agents and brokers sourced from the Florida DBPR (Department of Business and Professional Regulation) public records system — a free, weekly-updated CSV with zero authentication required. DBPR exports 327,000+ active/inactive licensees including salesperson, broker, and broker-associate ranks, with license number, status, name, DBA, mailing address, county, original issue date, and expiration date. RealEstateAgentData.com and BookYourData both sell formatted versions of this same data at undisclosed but material prices, proving a strong buyer market. A one-time $39–$59 FL-only CSV targets the real estate SaaS SDR, mortgage lender, and proptech vendor who needs to reach Florida's 300K+ agents without paying for a national subscription database.

audience.who: Real estate SaaS vendors (CRM platforms: Follow Up Boss, Lofty, kvCORE, Sierra Interactive) whose SDRs cold-call brokerages and agents; mortgage lenders and loan officers sourcing referral partner lists; title insurance companies doing agent outreach; errors & omissions (E&O) insurance brokers; continuing education providers selling real estate CE credits; proptech companies selling transaction management, showing software, or e-signature tools to agents.

data_wanted: License code, licensee name, DBA name, rank (Sales Associate, Broker, Broker Associate), mailing address (street, city, state, ZIP), county name, license number, primary status (Active, Inactive), original license date, expiration date — all sourced from DBPR weekly CSV download at myfloridalicense.com/real-estate-commission/public-records/, no authentication required.

willingness_to_pay.signal: At least three commercial vendors (RealEstateAgentData.com, BookYourData, USAgentLeads) package and sell this same DBPR-derived dataset at prices ranging from $49/state upward. Real estate SaaS SDRs at companies like Lofty, Follow Up Boss, and kvCORE actively need outreach lists of active agents and brokerages. A one-time $49 FL CSV is a no-brainer purchase compared to paying a national data subscription for 2M+ records when the buyer only needs FL.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/realtors, r/RealEstate, r/SaaS (RE software vendors angle), LinkedIn targeting real estate SaaS SDRs, mortgage loan officers, and title company marketing teams
first_sale_path.angle: "Florida Licensed Real Estate Agents & Brokers — 2026 Database, 300,000+ Records, CSV" — license type, active status, name, address, county, license #, expiration date. Positioned against $49+ state-slice competitors: 'Same DBPR data. $39. No subscription. Every active FL agent and broker in one clean CSV, ready to import into Salesforce or HubSpot.' FL is the largest single-state market for real estate activity and SaaS vendor SDR lists.
